title: Efficient couplings in acute triangles
exact_target: Can reflected Brownian motions in an acute triangle be coupled to meet with the prescribed nearly spectral exponential tail?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9500004 (AMR-094-0004). CC BY 4.0.
